accounting_convention.owner_answer_verbatim: `PHASE_TOTAL_FLOW` — book all Xe during purge, preheat, ignition, keeper/cathode operation, transition and fallback. No unbooked preheat flow.
accounting_convention.v1_definition: Each phase term (startup, transition, fallback) carries the TOTAL Xe flow during that phase (anode-side Xe plus cathode Xe). m_cathode carries the cathode flow over t_firing only. Phase hours are booked in their own terms. Where a phase's hours are also counted inside t_firing, the cathode flow over those hours is booked twice, at most mdot_cathode x overlap hours (conservative).
accounting_convention.overlap_rule: phase hours also counted in t_firing book the cathode flow twice (conservative, v1 rule)
